The author of **Pacem in Terris** was **Pope John XXIII**, who died on June 3, 1963 in **Vatican City**.

Vatican City became its own independent country on **February 11, 1929**, when the Lateran Treaty was signed between the Holy See and the Kingdom of Italy. This treaty recognized Vatican City as a sovereign state under the governance of the Pope, establishing it as the world's smallest country.
